inspection: All16 source and geometry cards, six actual room maps and six whole assemblies manually inspected; runtime review pending.

entries.label: Contest terminal upper housing
entries.reason: The black upper band and surrounding lobby wall are source background. Replace the extracted mass with a bounded pale terminal cap above the shared monitor.

entries.label: Contest terminal projected foot on tan floor
entries.reason: This is the walkable floor cell below the PC. The vent pixels project from the PC above; show only the native lower tan floor pixels on a thin horizontal surface.

entries.label: Devon president glass display upper half
entries.reason: Retain the bounded upright glass face and chamfered narrow sides; joined to its existing lower half, the blue reflection remains on the front and the carpet stays outside the occupied footprint.

entries.label: Devon president glass display lower half
entries.reason: Retain the supported display body, separate gold lower band and two feet with air between them; the existing cap-to-base pair forms one tall glass case in both Devon3F placements.

entries.label: Devon entry glass pedestal
entries.reason: Retain the rounded glass shell above a separate ochre pedestal, with outer carpet corners omitted. The source wall frieze behind it belongs to a different shared cell and is recorded for separate false-stack correction.

entries.label: Battle Tent terminal upper housing
entries.reason: Remove the purple surrounding wall/floor mass from the PC cap. The small pale housing joins the existing shared-PC support while retaining its established on link.

entries.label: Battle Tent projected terminal foot
entries.reason: All three lobby occurrences place this source below the PC on walkable purple floor. Exclude the projected vent from the physical surface and map native lower purple pixels horizontally.

entries.label: Battle Tent registration console left side
entries.reason: Retain the left green frame, pale inset body and adjoining yellow counter section; the actual three-cell console has a continuous top and discrete upright controls.

entries.label: Battle Tent registration console controls
entries.reason: Retain the central pale key/display panels inside the green casing, with a separate raised top badge; its side profile has real depth and joins the two matching counter sections.

entries.label: Battle Tent registration console right side
entries.reason: Retain the right green upright, pale side bracket and yellow counter end; the whole three-cell assembly keeps an open underside rather than extruding the nearby floor.

entries.label: Union wall display upper left
entries.reason: Replace the disconnected rear strip with the upper-left slice of one shallow wall, preserving pale trim over the red lower panel and cropping surrounding empty space.

entries.label: Union wall display upper centre
entries.reason: Join the pale upper trim and gold sign-frame top into the same two-row wall assembly; source green display pixels remain on its front only.

entries.label: Union wall display lower left
entries.reason: Replace the stepped extracted wedge with the left red wall panel of the complete shallow wall, continuous with the central display surround.

entries.label: Union wall display controls
entries.reason: Give the green display a thin recessed face within a projecting gold rectangular frame, mounted on the continuous red wall instead of a broad yellow roof-like lump.

entries.label: Union wall display upper right
entries.reason: Join the right pale wall trim to the complete two-row panel; rear and side materials exclude the green controls from the central cell.

entries.label: Union wall display lower right
entries.reason: Retain the right red-panel drawing on the front of a shallow shared wall, eliminating the separate wedge and keeping the yellow frame at the actual display edge.
